title: What came between Chera dynasty and Kingdom of Thiruvithamkoor?
question: What came between Chera dynasty and Kingdom of Thiruvithamkoor?
claim: 2 documented links lead from Chera dynasty (800) to Kingdom of Thiruvithamkoor (1729): 0 of cause and effect, 2 of succession.
why: Each record is joined to the one before it by a Wikidata statement (has effect, has cause, followed by, follows, replaced by, replaces), and the dates run forward. The longest such chain from the first record was taken, preferring cause and effect.

records.description: one of the three major kingdoms of ancient south India. Ruled over parts of present-day states of Kerala and Tamil Nadu in south India
